Persona Builder

Build detailed enterprise buyer personas with AI assistance. Generate profiles, journey maps, and content recommendations for your target C-suite.

How This Lab Works

Input your product details and select the personas you need. The AI will generate comprehensive buyer profiles including:

🗺️ What You'll Get

  • Role Overview — Responsibilities, reporting, KPIs
  • Priorities & Pain Points — What keeps them up at night
  • Buying Role — Economic, technical, user, champion, or gatekeeper
  • Journey Engagement — When/how they engage at each stage
  • Messaging Hooks — What resonates with this persona
  • Buying Committee Summary — How personas interact in deals
